title: cmux NEXT customization showcase: each example's first render

steps.title: My PRs: first render in a fresh capture app (skills/cmux-customization/templates/pull-watch/main.js rendered as the customize app)
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && cp {repo}/skills/cmux-customization/templates/pull-watch/main.js "$D/main.js" && sed 's#"local/showcase-[a-z-]*"#"local/customize"#' {repo}/skills/cmux-customization/templates/pull-watch/cmux-app.json > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved pull-watch
